Meet your neighbor

Rooted in Our Community.
Committed to Our Future.

Beaufort County is where I went to school, where I’m raising my twins, and where I run a small business. It’s the community I know and care about.

As a parent and community volunteer, I know our schools are about more than what happens in a board meeting. They’re about the children in our classrooms, the people teaching them, and the families counting on us.

    An appreciation for careful planning and responsible decisions.

  • Community volunteer

    A belief that caring about your community means showing up.
